// types / arrays / dynamic slices fixed and tuples
type Dynamic = uint8[];
// <- keyword.declaration.type.ds

type Slice = [uint8];
//           ^ punctuation.section.brackets.begin.ds

type Fixed<comptime N: uint> = [uint8; N];

type Pair = (string, uint32);

// types / arrays / readonly
type ReadonlyNames = readonly string[];
// <- keyword.declaration.type.ds
